audience: online shops and merchants in Poland that take payments through Przelewy24

useCases.title: Check a payment and the refunds of its order
useCases.text: Look up a payment by its session ID to read the status, amount, order ID and payment method. Then list the refund requests of its order.

useCases.title: Confirm API access and list payment methods
useCases.text: Check that the account ID and reports key work in the chosen environment. Then list the payment methods for an amount and currency.

useCases.title: Review settlement batches for a period
useCases.text: List the settlement history for up to 31 days. Open a batch to read its transactions, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Send a buyer a payment link
useCases.text: Register a payment with a unique session ID. Redirect the buyer to the returned payment link, where the buyer pays on Przelewy24's page.

useCases.title: Refund one or more transactions
useCases.text: Request a refund for one or more transactions with unique request IDs. Then list the refunds of the order. The refund result arrives asynchronously at your status URL.
